defects.title: SSE supervisor endpoint timeout on concurrent connections
defects.description: When multiple supervisor chat sessions open simultaneously, the SSE stream for /api/agentic-console/supervisor/chat/stream times out after 30s leaving stale connections.
defects.error: Response timeout after 30000ms — connection pool exhausted
notes: Investigate SSE connection leak in events route
Check node:fs readFileSync backpressure in high-concurrency mode

defects.title: QualityPage modal close button not focusable via keyboard
defects.description: The × close button in the agent detail modal does not receive focus when tabbing through the UI, failing WCAG 2.1 keyboard accessibility.
defects.testName: closes agent modal with close button
defects.error: Element is not focusable — missing tabIndex or role='button'
notes: Modal close button needs role='button' attribute

defects.title: PipelineGraph positions overlap for agents with long names
defects.description: When agent role names exceed 40 characters, the card width (200px) causes text overflow and horizontal overlap between adjacent cards.
defects.testName: places agents in correct phase columns
defects.error: Text overflow causes x-position overlap: expected gap 220px, got 180px
notes: Fixed by adding text-truncate with ellipsis class
Reduced font size for long names to fit node width

defects.title: HealthPage crashes when metric contains NaN duration
defects.description: If avg_duration_ms is NaN (division by zero in backend), the formatDuration helper returns 'NaN' string, rendering blank on the dashboard.
defects.error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')
notes: Backend now returns 0 instead of NaN for zero-execution agents

defects.title: SSE events route crashes on large state files (>5MB)
defects.description: When STATE_MATRIX.json exceeds 5MB, reading synchronously blocks the event loop for >2s, causing the SSE connection to be dropped by the browser.
defects.error: ReadableStream controller error: stream closed before response ended
notes: Consider streaming file reads with fs.createReadStream
Implement file size check before sync read
Add file watch instead of polling every 3s

defects.title: Dashboard progress ring shows wrong percentage for completed agents
defects.description: The progress ring displays (completed/sum) instead of (completed/total), causing incorrect percentage when some agents are in awaiting_approval or failed states.
defects.testName: renders dashboard with initialState and shows progress ring
defects.error: Expected 20%, got 33% — used completed/active instead of completed/total

defects.title: Operations page token chart fails for empty session array
defects.description: When token usage API returns { sessions: [], summary: null }, the recharts BarChart throws because data prop is undefined.
defects.testName: shows no token usage data message
defects.error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'total_sessions')
notes: Added null check for summary before rendering chart
Empty state now shows 'No token usage data yet'

defects.title: Breadcrumb fails to show project param on deep nested pages
defects.description: On pages like /agentic-console/agents/detail/00_supervisor?project=petestore, the breadcrumb Console link drops the project param.
defects.testName: includes project param in links when present
notes: breadcrumb link builder only reads first-level searchParams

defects.title: Agent detail API returns 500 when registry entry missing
defects.description: If an agent exists in state matrix but not in AGENT_REGISTRY.json, the detail endpoint crashes on registryEntry.role access.
defects.testName: returns 200 with null state when file missing
defects.error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'role')
notes: Added null guard before accessing registryEntry properties
Route now returns null for registryEntry when not found

defects.title: Layout menu button invisible on mobile Safari
defects.description: The hamburger menu button has display:none on .lg\:hidden class that doesn't apply correctly in Safari's older CSS engine.
defects.error: Element is not visible — computed style 'display:none' in Safari
notes: Use @media (max-width: 1023px) instead of lg:hidden Tailwind class
